description: JSON template for synthetic outpatient mental health client records used for local development fixtures. All generated records must be synthetic and must not be copied from real clients, staff, clinical notes, screenshots, exports, logs, or production systems.

intended_use: Agentic Wiki synthetic clinical workflow testing
generation_constraints: Use fake names, fake organizations, fake addresses, fake phone numbers, and fake email domains only.
Do not use actual client, guardian, staff, school, employer, referral source, payer, or provider names.
Do not use copied clinical notes or deidentified real notes.
Use DSM-5-style diagnostic labels only as synthetic documentation fields, not as reproduced diagnostic criteria.
Preserve provenance for every generated evaluation, treatment-plan, and session-note claim.
Treat every generated record as one pseudonymous client record.

minimal_discharge_criteria: Client has met or substantially met primary SMART goals.
Client demonstrates use of agreed coping, communication, relapse-prevention, or safety strategies outside session.

Risk level is stable and manageable at the current or lower level of care.
Client and clinician have reviewed a maintenance, relapse-prevention, or transition plan.
Follow-up care, community supports, or referrals are documented when ongoing support is needed.
